snippet.title: Snot Pop! - Beta Footage
snippet.description:
Snot Pop! (June 2026 Beta)

Snot Pop! is a 1990s arcade-style pixel platformer set in the sewer beneath the Goblin castle. The goblin princess has been kidnapped by the Mouldlings, purple sentient mould-goops with legs. You play as a determined goblin in a loincloth, clearing the tunnels to find out where they took the princess. Blow snot bubbles to trap enemies, pop them to splat them, grab coins, clear levels, and push deeper into the slime. Cute, disgusting, and built for fast-paced arcade time trials.
